# PURE POWER 12 

## Exceptional quiet, superior features

Pure Power 12 is be quiet!’s entry in the ATX 3 era. The PSU series is fully equipped with high-class technology such as LLC topology and up to 5 PCI express connectors for both PCIe 5.1 GPUs and GPUs with PCIe 6+2 connectors. It can handle power excursions up to double its rated power with ease. This makes Pure Power 12 the perfect choice for all who strive for a PSU with high performance and yet very low noise for their current- or next-gen graphics card.
